stem: Which drawing best shows how the light ray travels after it reaches the surface of the mirror?

options.label: A
options.text: Light ray reflecting off the mirror to the right

options.label: B
options.text: Light ray reflecting off the mirror back toward the lighted bulb

options.label: C
options.text: Light ray reflecting off the mirror upward to the left

options.label: D
options.text: Light ray reflecting off the mirror upward to the right

visual_elements: Diagram of light ray traveling horizontally from lighted bulb toward a mirror tilted upward
Four option diagrams labeled A, B, C, D each showing a lighted bulb, mirror, and different reflected light ray directions
